diagnosis.overview: The agent lacks a reliable mechanism to fully extract and assemble all required data points from complex source documents, causing repeated tool errors, iteration exhaustion, and systematic omission of critical deliverable elements (e.g., $929,354.31 prepaid balance, 54 tax return data points, GL Balance/Variance checks, TOC hyperlinks).
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent lacks a reliable mechanism to fully extract and assemble all required data points from complex source documents, causing repeated tool errors, iteration exhaustion, and systematic omission of critical deliverable elements (e.g., $929,354.31 prepaid balance, 54 tax return data points, GL Balance/Variance checks, TOC hyperlinks).
diagnosis.general_mechanism: Wire in a robust document/text extraction TOOL (e.g. a specialized Excel/PDF reader) that is currently unbound in agent.yaml, and add a prompt rule that forces the agent to enumerate all required deliverables upfront and verify each section before finalizing (preventing omission loops).
